source_caption:
🎬 Regarding Henry (1991)

Regarding Henry follows Henry Turner, a successful but arrogant New York City lawyer whose life changes dramatically after he is shot during a convenience store robbery. Surviving the incident with severe memory loss, Henry must relearn basic skills and rebuild his identity with the help of his family and a compassionate physical therapist. As he gradually recovers, he discovers uncomfortable truths about his former personality, professional career, and strained relationships with his wife, Sarah, and daughter, Rachel. Given a second chance at life, Henry begins developing a more compassionate outlook and reevaluating what truly matters. Starring Harrison Ford and Annette Bening, the film delivers powerful performances and heartfelt storytelling while exploring redemption, personal transformation, forgiveness, family relationships, and the importance of appreciating life’s meaningful moments.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 48m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Mike Nichols

✍️ Writer: J. J. Abrams

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Paramount+ for current availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Regarding Henry is a 1991 American drama film directed by Mike Nichols and written by J.J. Abrams. It stars Harrison Ford as a New York City lawyer from a dysfunctional family, who struggles to regain his memory and recover his speech and mobility after he survives a shooting, inadvertently restoring his family's integrity in the process. The supporting cast includes Annette Bening, Mikki Allen, Bill Nunn, Rebecca Miller, Bruce Altman, and Elizabeth Wilson. Regarding Henry was released by Paramount Pictures on July 12, 1991.
